static_traits.name: Li Wendi
static_traits.social_status: 有少数密友但not yet向其倾诉Divorce与not yet来关系的担忧；因害怕再次受伤而Avoids socializing与发展新关系
static_traits.medical_history: Divorce前not yet出现类似心理问题；既往without心理治疗经历；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude、配合度高；能清晰表达并识do not内部对话与自动化思维；思路清楚、逻辑性Good；略感紧张但抱有希望

basic_info.main_problem: 由于过去的Divorce，我相信自己再也not会结婚并获得幸福，这让我感到despair和without望。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts about relationships are affecting my overall well-being and causing distress; I really want to change the way I think and feel.
growth_experiences: 两年前经历Divorce，Divorce后感到极度压力、心碎与迷失（“觉得自己not知道是谁了”）。自那时起，这种感受持续存在，并在Seeing happy couples时反复被激活，伴随“再也not会结婚并幸福”的信念。该事件对其生活产生长期影响：Avoids socializing和发展新关系、害怕再次心碎，睡眠与饮食模式受影响，Decline in work performance，且难以向密友敞开谈及Divorce与对not yet来关系的担忧。

core_beliefs: 离过婚的人not配拥有幸福

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人都在关系里很幸福，而我已Divorce，这意味着我not会再有机会获得同样的幸福
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing与关系场景、移开视线或Displacement注意力，投入Work与爱好分散情绪
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那种幸福与我without关；我永远not会再结婚也not会幸福

special_situations.event: Considering whether to start a new intimate relationship
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我再次尝试亲密关系，我一定会再次心碎和Being rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Withdrawing in advance and avoiding building new relationships to avoid potential hurt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会再次受伤，还是not要开始比较安全

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 离过婚等同失败，失败者not值得被爱
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 给自己贴标签、以极端标准评判自我来“提醒”自己not要再尝试

special_situations.event: 在Work中成功救治病人并Gaining recognition
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Work上的价值与被爱without关，这些积极证据not能改变我注定Loneliness的现实
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate与贬低正向证据，迅速将注意力转回负性预测
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些not算数，我的关系仍然not会好转

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be loved and accepted, longing to rebuild a safe and stable intimate relationship
core_conflict.fear: 害怕再次心碎与Being rejected，担心脆弱暴露会带来伤害与羞耻
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of getting hurt by keeping distance and avoiding intimacy
Presses painful emotions down by investing in work and hobbies, maintaining a superficial sense of control and stability

object_relations.self_representation: 被抛弃、not可被爱的失败者
object_relations.object_representation: Potential partners/others are people who may hurt and reject oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询深入到Divorce经历与对not yet来关系的脆弱感受时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that exposing vulnerability will lead to being judged or hurt again, so I need to press the pain down
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和、先Empathy后Clarification；允许停顿与情感表达，use开放式问题邀请描述当下身体感受与情绪，not急于追问细节，给予安全边界与选择权。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to try small-scale socializing outside the session or share feelings with a trusted person
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将尝试视为高风险，担忧Being rejected或自我失控，于是用“忙碌/without暇”等理由延后或取消
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用支持性与合作式语气，运用动机性访谈风格，肯定其谨慎与Self-protection；与来访者共同将目标微量化，强调可选择性与可撤回性，降低威胁感。

manifestations: Divorce后反复出现“我注定会Loneliness”的信念
Avoids socializing与发展新关系，难以向密友敞开谈及Divorce与not yet来担忧
Divorce后感到“我not知道我是谁了”，角色与自我认同动摇
Positive moments (such as treating patients) are hard to internalize as a lasting sense of self-worth
outcomes: Inner emptiness and sense of loss
对not yet来的希望感降低，Work受情绪困扰

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: 想寻求亲近与支持却选择独自承受，not向密友倾诉Divorce后的感受
回避开始新关系，将能量转为自我克制与Repression

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 自我贴上“not可被爱/失败者”的标签，Excessive self-blame和自我限制
在社交前过度担心Being rejected，因而谨小慎微甚至Withdrawal

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'. Language manifestations include: 'Speaking of which... haha, just kidding', 'In theory...', and so on
manifestations: 通过投入Work与爱好分散注意，避免直接接触悲伤、Loneliness与Being rejected的Fear
After positive moments appear, quickly shifts attention away, finding it hard to stay with and absorb positive feelings

exception_events.target_problem: 在面对亲密关系与自我价值议题时，来访者通常会陷入“我not被爱/注定Loneliness”的想法，并产生despair感与Avoids socializing的行为。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在急诊室成功救治患者的时刻，来访者have not陷入“I am worthless”的旧有自我评价，而是体验到“我很有能力、被需要与被认可”，该积极感受虽not持久但清晰可感。
exception_events.reason: 线索：情境中目标明确、结果可见（救治成功）带来即时正向反馈，激活胜任与价值感，从而在当下弱化了关于“注定Loneliness/not可被爱”的负性自我叙事。

positive_force: Experiences competence and recognition in professional settings, which can activate a sense of value
Clear motivation for help and a positive attitude, willing to change thoughts and behaviors
能识do not并表述自动化思维，具有一定自我觉察能力
Maintains daily activities and hobbies, with a certain degree of life structure and capacity for action
Has a few close friends as potential support resources
negative_force: 灾难化、预测not yet来与非黑即白等认知扭曲Reinforcementwithout望感
自我标签化（“失败者/not可被爱”）损害自我价值
对亲密关系的回避维持了Loneliness与负性信念的自证循环
害怕再次心碎导致not愿尝试与暴露脆弱
Sleep and diet affected、Work受损，进一步削弱Self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids socializing与避免发展新关系
antecedent: Thinking of starting a new relationship or being invited to socialize
target_behavior.core_reason: Divorce创伤后对再次心碎与Being rejected的强烈Fear，并由灾难化与预测not yet来等认知扭曲维持
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在情感伤害与not确定性，从而短期缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 持续的Loneliness与隔离，负性信念得到自我验证，Decreased quality of life且Decreased sense of happiness

target_behavior.behavior: 关于婚姻与幸福的反复负性思维（灾难化与“再也not会幸福”的自我暗示）
target_behavior.core_reason: Divorce导致的自我认同动摇与创伤性记忆激活，伴随黑白分明与预测not yet来等认知偏差
target_behavior.function: 获得一种“预先防御”的控制感与对风险的虚假预警，短期减少not确定性带来的Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: despair与without望感加重，睡眠与饮食受损，Decline in work performance，Social avoidance被进一步Reinforcement
